paper.title_en: The Quantum Boundary of Black Hole Interiors: Signature Failure and the Termination of Mass Inflation
paper.abstract_en: Classical general relativity predicts a singularity at the center of every black hole. We argue that it is never reached. We adopt the conjecture of Shaya (2026) that a metric element of non-Lorentzian signature is inadmissible: it cannot enter the Feynman sum over geometries, and so cannot belong to the physical manifold. Nothing beyond standard quantum mechanics is invoked. Signature is the only pointwise diffeomorphism-invariant content of the metric, so the criterion is local and coordinate independent. Transverse-traceless graviton vacuum fluctuations grow as $Δ_g = \sqrt{8/π}\,\ell_P/q$ on a scale $q$, and any finite-scale metric stress driving an eigenvalue through zero removes that element. When the surviving elements can no longer sustain connected, differentiable, causally propagating support, the manifold terminates on a quantum boundary $\mathcal{B}_Q$ at finite radius. For the vacuum Schwarzschild interior the tidal Weyl stress gives $r_{\rm qb} \simeq 1.0\times10^{-22}(M/M_\odot)^{1/3}$~m for the adopted curvature response $C_W=0.15$. For a spinning hole, the boundary forms much farther out: mass inflation at the inner horizon $r_{-}$ concentrates an exponentially growing interior mass into a thin layer whose thickness is set by the accretion rate and floored at one spatial quantum, and the counter-streaming null fluxes supply a trace-free Ricci stress along the radial axis alone. This caps the factor $n_{\rm qb}$ by which mass inflation can amplify the interior mass function, at between $10^{38}$ and $10^{69}$ for a $10\,M_\odot$ hole depending on its accretion history, and leaves the Cauchy horizon, the ring, and all deeper extensions outside the physical manifold. The Gibbons--Hawking--York term over this terminal slice yields a finite interior action, $S_{GHY}^{qb} \approx \frac{3}{2} n_{\rm qb} Mc^2\,Δt$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文聚焦黑洞内部奇点是否实际形成这一广义相对论基础问题，提出用非洛伦兹签名不可容许性来终止流形的判据，并给出量子边界半径、质量膨胀放大因子上限与Gibbons-Hawking-York项作用量等定量结果，理论深度与新颖性均较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞内部结构的量子边界：签名失效与质量膨胀的终止
decision.abstract_zh: 经典广义相对论预言每个黑洞中心都存在奇点。我们主张这一奇点永远不会被到达。我们采纳 Shaya（2026）的猜想：非洛伦兹签名的度规元素是不可容许的——它不能进入费曼几何求和，因此不能属于物理流形。这里没有引入任何超出标准量子力学的东西。签名是度规中唯一逐点的微分同胚不变内容，因此该判据是局域的且与坐标无关。横向无迹引力子真空涨落在尺度 $q$ 上按 $Δ_g = \sqrt{8/π}\,\ell_P/q$ 增长，任何驱动本征值穿过零的有限尺度度规应力都会移除该元素。当幸存元素再也无法维持连通的、可微的、因果传播的支撑时，流形就在有限半径处的量子边界 $\mathcal{B}_Q$ 上终止。对于真空 Schwarzschild 内部，潮汐 Weyl 应力给出，在所选曲率响应 $C_W=0.15$ 下，$r_{\rm qb} \simeq 1.0\times10^{-22}(M/M_\odot)^{1/3}$~m。对于旋转黑洞，边界形成的位置要远得多：内视界 $r_{-}$ 处的质量膨胀把指数增长的内禀质量集中到一个薄层中，该薄层的厚度由吸积率决定，并以一个空间量子为下限，而反向流动的零通量只沿径向轴提供无迹 Ricci 应力。这给质量膨胀放大内部质量函数的因子 $n_{\rm qb}$ 设定了上限，对于 $10\,M_\odot$ 黑洞，该上限在 $10^{38}$ 到 $10^{69}$ 之间，取决于其吸积历史，并且使 Cauchy 视界、环以及所有更深的外延都处于物理流形之外。对这一终止切片上的 Gibbons--Hawking--York 项给出有限的内部作用量，$S_{GHY}^{qb} \approx \frac{3}{2} n_{\rm qb} Mc^2\,Δt$。
